verdict.rationale: xAI documents a public REST API that is OpenAI-compatible, alongside a gRPC API, a Management API, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key). Onboarding is self-serve via API keys with runnable quickstart examples, and documented endpoints cover inference, tools, batch, models, and management. The probe and community usage via OpenRouter, Cursor and Grok Build corroborate that the API is real and used in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The xAI REST API is compatible with the OpenAI REST API.
The xAI gRPC API exposes the same models and services as the REST API over gRPC.
The Management API serves as a dedicated interface to the xAI platform, empowering developers and teams to programmatically manage their xAI API teams.
